context.content: I've skimmed through the subreddit, in desperate need of a solution. From what I understand, there were plans to launch a web-based version of Bear. Are such plans still in effect, and would we expect to see it any time soon? With Android as my new daily driver (and seemingly no plans to develop for it), a web-based version would be fantastic for those who indulge in platform independency. The macOS app is dynamite; I'd like to continue using it as my main entry method (markdown implementation is eons ahead of any competition), but the absence of some sort of web-based responsive website to access the information on a variety of platforms is my only setback. I'd appreciate any level of feedback. Loving the Bear experience!
